children: Skkynet Cloud Systems, Inc. reported results for the quarter ended 2026, with revenue of $560.5K, up 16.1% from $482.68K a year earlier, while net loss widened slightly to ($19.75K) and diluted EPS was $0— per the company's 10-Q filing.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Income (loss) to common stockholders”. ³ Reported as “income per share to common stockholders- basic and diluted”.
Revenue trend: Three-month revenue grew 16% year over year, but nine-month revenue declined 9% as the company transitions from perpetual to subscription licensing.
Channel shift: Management is moving from perpetual licenses toward subscription licensing, creating timing-driven quarterly variability while aiming to build recurring SaaS revenue.
Investment in growth: The company increased spending on advertising, staffing and consultants to support expansion in SaaS and Industry 4.0 offerings.
Product focus: Emphasis on cloud-based SaaS for Industrial IoT with integration of Cogent to expand real-time industrial monitoring capabilities.
Operational impact: Investments have increased operating losses in the near term, with revenue variability tied to timing of closed opportunities as recurring revenue is developed.
